limitations: Endpoints come from separate deterministic same-config coldboots, not a single run with continuous in-flight counter sampling.
This is one no-input interval in expanded-memory emulation, not a physical machine/fullmatch or interactive latency benchmark.
Different variants reach different source-game phases by each endpoint; CPU-only and synthetic-renderer percentages must not be substituted for this throughput.
No zero-Fast stock or full-speed acceptance.
The player skips up to three consecutive picture conversions when late. Source updates are not displayed frames; native PCM hash equality is not real-time audio playback acceptance.
